label: D2 after choosing a2, late in episode / low value (esp. rare S1)
explanation: Reset-gate unit 7 is almost exclusively a D2 unit (97% of mass) that fires only after the agent chose a2 (99% of mass; in_action==2 input). It is gated by episode progress: ~99% of mass is at ep_trial >= 50 and rate climbs steeply to trials 90-99; the model value head (which declines over the episode) captures this best, with no activation at value >= 7.54. Within that, a rare transition to S1 after a2 gives the largest activations (top windows are runs of a2 -> S1 rare, reaching max on repeated rare-unrewarded trials while S2 is good), so the S1 clause uses a looser value cutoff. Common a2 -> S2 D2 steps fire weaker (~0.3-0.7 of max) and only very late. Nearly silent at D1 and GO and after a1 choices. All variables are observed at D2 (choice, reached state, model value). Dev F1 0.78, precision 0.72, mass recall 0.94; simpler (D2 & a2 & value < 6.9) gives F1 0.70. Residual false positives are late a2 D2 steps that stay off, suggesting magnitude also depends on recent a2 history/rare count that I did not capture.
